dreamteamer.title: HTTP
dreamteamer.description: Deprecated: dt serve moved to @dreamteamer/web (dt web token), and this package gets no new routes. dt serve here is a JSON REST api at /api over a dreamteamer workspace, through the same validating store the CLI uses: records, collections and fields behind a real compile, history and bound commands. Loopback by default; a wider host needs a bearer token.
